description:
The first Super Mario game to feature 3D gameplay, it features freedom of movement within a large open world based on polygons,
combined with traditional Mario gameplay, visual style, and characters.

spicy-0.0.4.description:
You must re-build sm64ex if you have an older version!

## New Features

- Added Purple Switches as unlockable progression items.
- Added Wet-Dry World Water Level Diamonds as unlockable progression items.
- Added Tick Tock Clock Spinners as unlockable progression items.
- Added Mario's Hat as an optional item that can be shuffled.
- Added an unlock item for Bowser in the Fire Sea.

## New Randomization Options

- All level-feature shuffles that were not originally act-specific features can now be toggled through YAML options.
- Rolling Logs now shuffles the Tall, Tall Mountain Rolling Log in addition to the Lethal Lava Land Rolling Log, and can now be shuffled as either a single global item or individual level-specific items, and now includes the Rolling Log in 
- Purple Switches can now be shuffled as either a single global item or individual level-specific items.
- Checkerboard Platforms can now be shuffled as either a single global item or individual level-specific items.

## Coin Star Changes

- Coins Star checks have been renamed from "100 Coins" to "Coins Star."
- Coins Stars are now always included and can no longer be disabled.
- Added YAML options to configure the Coins Star requirement for each main course individually.

## Level Changes

- Defeating Big Boo in Big Boo's Haunt no longer spawns the staircase star.
- The Big Boo star has been moved to the ground floor near the staircase.

## Interface Improvements

- Redesigned the pause menu to display per-level feature unlocks and Coins Star coin requirements.
- Moved the HUD coin counter to the top-right corner of the screen.
- Simplified file select progress displays.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed music shuffle.

spicy-0.1.0.description:
You must build the 0.1.0 sm64ex build for use with this apworld. Going forward, updates that break compatibility between the apworld and the  sm64ex build will increment the first or second value of the version number, non-breaking updates will increment the last value. The "archipelago" sm64ex branch will always be the latest, but you may also enter a version number to get an older version.

- Non-stop mode is enabled by default, with a patch file provided to return it to "stop mode."
- Freestanding 1-Ups and "Exclamation Boxes" have been combined into one option: One Up Checks.
- A new option has been added: Blocksanity. Adds checks for breaking all exclamation blocks and cap blocks.
- Hazy Maze Cave is now included in Locked Paintings.
- Tiny Island and Huge Island paintings are unlocked separately.
- Several logic adjustments and fixes.
- Location and Item name groups have been added.
- Item name and classifications were adjusted.
- No Despawns now grants coins and 1-Ups that end up on deadly quicksand. Mini Goombas now drop their coin if they attack.
- The coins spawned during the final Bowser battle no longer increment your coin counter.

spicy-0.2.0.description:
This is a large update, please report any bugs or issues!

## Major Features

- Save progress is now stored with the Archipelago slot on the server, and the file-select screen is skipped after
  connecting and loading server data. Save prompts are removed.
- Added Permanent Coin Collection option. Previously collected coins appear as transparent gray coins that can heal Mario without increasing the coin counter. Permanent coins synchronize between multiple game instances connected to the same slot.
- Newly received feature, object, enemy, and 1-Up unlocks can take effect without leaving the current level.
- Added Uncollect Random Coin Traps, which remove one previously collected coin when Permanent Coin Collection is
  enabled.
- Collapsed several individual toggles for Level Features into a single option controlling all of them.
- Added configurable Coin Object Unlocks, including individual or global unlocks for coin types and coin blocks.
- Added configurable Enemy Unlocks for coin-yielding enemies.
- Added configurable 1-Up Unlocks for freestanding 1-Ups, triggered 1-Ups, 1-Up Blocks, butterflies, and Monty Mole
  rewards.
- Added option for Bob-omb Buddy items for every level.
- Added Treasure Chest unlocks for Jolly Roger Bay and Dire, Dire Docks.
- Added Warp Pipe unlocks for all three Bowser stages, including a global Warp Pipes item.
- Added Unlock Rainbow Ride and Unlock Wing Mario Over the Rainbow items.
- Expanded Level Unlocks so all levels can optionally begin unlocked.
- Added Progressive Bowser Arena Bombs, globally or per level.
- Added configurable health for all three Bowser fights.
- Added configurable Bowser in the Sky arena-collapse health threshold.
- Added a separate Mario hat color option.
- Added Skybox Shuffle with fixed shuffled and random-on-load modes.

## Logic and Tracking

- Rebuilt the world logic using Archipelago's Rule Builder.
- Universal Tracker `/explain` now provides detailed explanations of location and Coin Star logic.
- Coin explanations identify individual reachable and unavailable coin sources.
- Replaced Strict Cap Requirements, Strict Cannon Requirements, and Strict Move Requirements with named tricks with
Easy, Medium, and Hard presets.
- Added a separate Universal Tracker Glitched Logic selection for tricks that should appear as glitched checks.

Logic Trick descriptions and available videos can be found in
[LogicTricks.py](https://github.com/Alchav/Archipelago/blob/spicy-mycena-64/worlds/sm64ex_spicy/LogicTricks.py).

## Fixes

- Fixed Snowman's Body disappearing after collecting Snowman's Lost His Head.

spicy-1.0.0.description:
## Coin System

- Permanent Coins is now the only coin-collection mode. The old `permanent_coin_collection` option has been removed.
- `Coinsanity` has been renamed to **Coin Count Checks**. These remain threshold checks within each course.
- Added **Coin Checks**, a percentage option that creates checks for individual physical coin outputs. Red and blue
  coins each produce one check.
- Added **Global Coin Count Checks**, which creates thresholds based on the combined permanent coin total of every
  course and secret stage.
- Added **Counts Coins Beyond Coin Stars**. When disabled, each course's contribution to the global total is capped at
  its configured Coin Star maximum; when enabled, every collectible coin contributes.
- Castle Grounds, Castle interior, and Castle Courtyard coins can be individual Coin Checks, but do not contribute to
  course or global Coin Count Checks because those areas have no coin counter.
- Secret-stage coin-count maximum options have been made hidden YAML options to reduce option bloat, and they default
  to the maximum, as secret stages generally are not annoying to collect all coins in.

## Entrance Shuffle

- Replaced the single Entrance Randomizer option with four independent options:
  - **Main Course Shuffle**: `vanilla`, `separate`, or `mixed`.
  - **Secret Course Shuffle**: `vanilla`, `separate`, or `mixed`.
  - **Sub-Area Shuffle**: `vanilla`, `separate`, `mixed`, or `mixed_decoupled`.
  - **Castle Return Shuffle**: `vanilla`, `mixed`, or `death`.
- Categories set to `separate` shuffle only within their own category. All categories set to `mixed` share one pool.
- Sub-Area Shuffle `mixed` keeps sub-areas with reusable exits coupled to the corresponding return destination.
  `mixed_decoupled` uses the same mixed pool but shuffles those entrances and exits independently.
- The client tracks nested shuffled entrances with a return stack. Death, Exit Course, and Star/key exits return through
  the route Mario actually entered, while vanilla Castle painting and course exits retain their normal presentation.
  Re-entering a zone already on the return stack collapses the loop instead of growing the stack indefinitely.

## Signs and Hints

- Signs may contain hints!
- Added **Sign Unlocks** with `not_shuffled`, `global`, `per_level`, and `both` modes. `Castle - Signs` covers signposts
  and wall-mounted signs in the Castle Grounds, Castle interior, and Castle Courtyard.

## Items and Item Pool

- Removed the `1-Up Mushroom` filler item and replaced it with three progressive fillers:
  - **Progressive Cap Length** adds 1% of vanilla duration to the shared cap timer per copy.
  - **Progressive Breath** increases time between underwater, cold-water, and toxic-gas health drain by 1% per copy.
  - **Progressive Damage Dodge** gives you an increasing chance to avoid damage.
- Lives are no longer part of gameplay. Life displays and Game Over behavior are removed. A 1-Up fully heals Mario when
  1-Up Checks are disabled.
- Added a `both` mode to Cap Items, Level Features, Bob-omb Buddies, Coin Object Unlocks, Enemy Unlocks, 1-Up Unlocks,
  Sign Unlocks, Bowser Arena Bombs, and Bowser Stage 1-Up Behavior where applicable. This places global and per-level
  forms in the same pool.
- Added separate secret-stage move items for BITDW, BITFS, BITS, VCUTM, COTMC, TOTWC, and WMOTR. The new **Combined
  Castle and Secret Stage Move Items** option collapses these back into shared `Misc` moves.
- Added level unlock items for Bob-omb Battlefield, The Princess's Secret Slide, The Secret Aquarium, and Cavern of the
  Metal Cap. With Full Level Unlocks, COTMC's door becomes a large locked Star door; PSS and SA warps remain disabled
  until unlocked.
- Expanded level-feature unlocks with Vertical Wind, Horizontal Wind, Freestanding Stars, Star Blocks, Koopa Shell
  Blocks, Star Secrets, Jet Streams, Cap Switches, and Dire, Dire Docks - Moat Exit.
- Added progression or trick-dependent enemy/object unlocks for Bowsers, Bob-omb Battlefield's Chain Chomp,
  Tiny-Huge Island's Wiggler, Wet-Dry World's Heave-Hos, and Shifting Sand Land's Tweesters.
- Added hazard/trap unlocks for Klepto, Amps, Mad Piano, Haunted Chairs, Sushi Sharks, Bubbas, Tox Boxes, Bowling Balls,
  Water Bombs, Boulders, Flamethrowers and Fire Bars, Bouncing Fireballs, Spindel, Falling Pillars, Fire Spitters, and
  Bubs.
- Klepto and Klepto with Star are independent SSL objects and unlock items. Both may be present at the same time.
- Added separate **Castle - Boos** item for coin-producing Courtyard Boos. The Lobby Boo and BBH entrance Boo are
  controlled by Unlock Big Boo's Haunt.
- Bowser Arena Bombs are individually numbered instead of progressive. Global Bomb 1-4 unlock the corresponding bomb
  in every arena; BITS has its own fifth bomb. Item-name groups support useful hints for global, per-level, and per-arena
  bomb sets.
- Mario's Hat becomes advancement when Lava Damage Boosting is enabled. If a hat-stealing enemy is unavailable, a lost
  hat is restored so it cannot become permanently inaccessible.

## Locations and Goals

- Added individual Coin Check locations for all courses, secret stages, Bowser stages, and Castle areas.
- Added Visit Checks for the player-visible zones: Castle floors, Castle Grounds/Courtyard, main courses, distinct
  slides/caves/interiors, cap stages, Bowser stages, and Bowser arenas. Internal areas that do not look like a separate
  zone, such as WDW Downtown and DDD's Bowser's Sub section, do not receive separate Visit Checks.
- Added **Bowser in the Sky - Grand Star** when Completion Goal is All Bowser Stages. The final undefeated Bowser among
  the three can start the ending sequence in whichever arena completes the goal.

### New Tricks

- Castle Lobby Backwards Long Jump Through the 8 Star Door (Hard).
- The Princess's Secret Slide Coin Triggers 1-Up without Coin Markers (Easy).
- Bob-omb Battlefield Island with Koopa Shell and Wing Cap (Easy).
- Bob-omb Battlefield Chain Chomp Gate with Throwable Cork Box Clip (Hard).
- Wet-Dry World Ground Pound Underwater Shocking Arrow Lifts Box (Easy).
- Wet-Dry World Pedestal with Heave-ho (Easy).
- Tall, Tall Mountain Upper Region with Spin Jump Off of Fly Guy (Easy).
- Tall, Tall Mountain Breathtaking View from Bridge with Triple Jump from Below (Medium).
- Rainbow Ride Fall to Tricky Triangles from Somewhere Over the Rainbow (Easy).
- Rainbow Ride Fall to Tricky Triangles 1-Up from Somewhere Over the Rainbow (Medium).

## Client and Interface

- Added Trigger Sparkles: green for 1-Up triggers, purple for 1-Up butterfly spots, blue for hidden warps, and yellow
  for Star Secrets and SSL pyramid triggers. Only available, unfinished triggers sparkle. Vanilla Star, 1-Up, shell,
  and other sparkle effects remain on their original code path and colors. Idea from a patch by @ItzLoonie, implemented
  independently.
- Coin-producing enemies and objects, Star-producing objects, blocks, Bob-omb Buddies, Bowsers, signs, Monty Moles,
  baby penguins, 1-Ups, and 1-Up blocks turn gray when all relevant rewards/checks are exhausted. Boos use the same
  readable gray treatment. Cap blocks keep a colored border around a gray center so their type remains visible.
- Added a single `CAP` timer for the shared vanilla cap timer. It stacks with race timers, disappears at zero, and
  repositions its fractional display for three-digit seconds.
- Cap stages ignore Progressive Cap Length for their automatically granted cap until that stage's cap item or the global
  cap has been received.
- Bowser-stage level-item menus display required Bowser health and the individually unlocked Bowser Bombs.
- The level-items and camera menus remain available whenever paused; only course-exit commands require Mario to be
  stationary.
- Blast to the Stone Pillar uses a Star Block in the JP build to be consistent with the US version.
- Fix for Better Camera Bowser-stage is applied automatically and no longer an optional patch.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed permanent coin formations reappearing yellow and becoming collectible again after moving between loaded areas.
  The old formation initialization restored only its behavior-parameter mask, not the server ledger's collected slots.
- Fixed Red Coin counters getting ahead of the number physically collected, resetting after slides/sub-areas, or
  requiring a reload to spawn the Star. The old code incremented the controller on interaction while separately
  reconstructing the count by scanning only currently loaded Red Coin objects.
- Fixed No Despawns granting coins on nonlethal surfaces and failing to grant some objects that actually reached a death
  plane. The old code maintained separate approximate floor/death-barrier tests instead of using death-surface behavior.
- Fixed spawned enemy/object coin outputs sharing, losing, or changing permanent source identities. The old generic loot
  helper inferred one slot range from `oNumLootCoins`, which could not distinguish separate reward methods or inherited
  child objects.
- Fixed Whomps granting Ground Pound-only coins after repeated jumps. The old jump and Ground Pound rewards used the same
  undifferentiated loot-slot assignment.
- Fixed reconnect reconciliation duplicating live coins, checking uncollected giant-Goomba outputs, and failing to gray
  some exhausted sources. The old reconciliation was a single boolean with no delay or semantic source catalog.
- Fixed coin-related server disconnects caused by overlapping raw JSON sends. In 0.2.3, normal location sends and
  permanent-ledger writes could independently call the AP transport without one serialized request path.
- Fixed global and per-level 1-Up unlock behavior depending on whether 1-Up Checks was enabled. The old runtime returned
  every source as unlocked whenever checks were disabled instead of treating received unlock items as authoritative.
- Fixed Bowser-stage return/camera handling being bypassed entirely for BITS and the third Bowser arena. The old redirect
  returned before applying any entrance handling for those levels.
- Fixed exit and death camera views after entrance randomization. Camera cutscenes now use the physical entrance Mario
  returns through instead of the randomized stage he exited, including Bowser exits, non-painting exits, and TTM's
  special painting camera. Adapted from a patch by @soopercool101
- Fixed Eyerok intermittently failing to appear or starting with only one hand when the object pool was temporarily full.
  The old initialization attempted each hand once and advanced regardless of whether either spawn failed.
- Fixed the DDD portal's visible barrier remaining forward after receiving the BITFS unlock.
- Fixed the Metal Cap object inheriting custom Mario hat colors. Its metal display lists used the same mutable lights as
  the ordinary cap instead of dedicated neutral metal lighting.
spicy-1.0.0.title: SM64: Spicy Mycena 64, version 1.0.0
